description: This file defines data models for tools within the MCP server, using pydantic's BaseModel. It includes classes for tool information, subcategory metadata, category metadata, and toggle results.

classes.name: ToolInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a single tool, including its name, activation status, and description.

classes.name: SubcategoryInfo
classes.description: Holds metadata for a tool subcategory, including its name and the count of tools.

classes.name: CategoryInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata for a category of tools, including its name, subcategories, and total number of tools.

classes.name: ToggleResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a request to activate or deactivate tools, including lists of successful and failed tool names, an action type, and a message.
